title: Regex script schema fields entirely undocumented
reality: packages/shared/src/schemas/regex.schema.ts defines a rich field set: findRegex, replaceString, flags, applyMode, placement, promptOnly, trimStrings, minDepth, maxDepth, order, enabled, targetCharacterIds, scriptIds. references/custom-tools.md describes Regex Scripts narratively ('each script pairs a regex find with a replace') and documents ZERO of these field names — grep returns 0 for every one.
fix: Add a field table to the Regex Scripts section of references/custom-tools.md. The depth window (minDepth/maxDepth), promptOnly, placement, and applyMode are the controls that make a regex script safe to run — without them the skill can only say 'use a regex script' and cannot say how to scope one. SKILL.md's routing table sends regex questions here, so the depth of coverage should match that promise.

title: Regex targetCharacterIds contradicts the documented per-character scoping model
reality: references/custom-tools.md states regex scripts are scoped 'per-character (Character editor's regex section) and per-preset (Presets panel)'. The schema carries targetCharacterIds (an array) on the script itself, which is a different and more flexible model — one script targeting a SET of characters rather than living inside one character's editor.
fix: Verify the actual scoping behavior against the client, then correct the Scope bullet in references/custom-tools.md. If a script can target multiple characters by ID, the current 'per-character' description understates it and would produce wrong advice for anyone building shared formatting rules across a cast.

title: Imported webhook tool hardening already captured — verify only
reality: v2.4.0 requires imported webhook functions to arrive disabled with hidden chat context access removed, with the Functions panel showing destination origin and requested privileges. references/custom-tools.md documents this in the new 'Import security (v2.4.0)' subsection, including the static/script exemption and the name-clash skip.
fix: No change needed. Recorded so consensus does not re-raise it.

title: Generated-image result URL restriction not documented
reality: v2.4.0 restricted private generated-image result URLs to the configured provider's exact scheme, hostname, and port. Public CDN results remain supported, but redirects from a trusted local image provider can no longer reach another private service. v2.4.0 also bounded NovelAI ZIP image decompression to 64 MiB with declared-vs-actual output matching.
fix: Add to the security material in references/custom-tools.md or architecture.md. Relevant to anyone running a local image provider behind a proxy — a previously-working redirect setup will now fail closed, and that needs to be diagnosable.
